title: Uniform probability of a predicate
statement: For a natural number $m$ and a decidable predicate $A$ on Boolean lists, let $X$ be uniformly distributed over the $2^m$ Boolean lists of length $m$. The quantity defined here is the probability that $A(X)$ holds.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ is a decidable predicate on Boolean lists
